name: Volatile Memory: Blood Trail
source:
In the midst of isolation, Artemis shares a cabin with an unusual stranger and a stubborn, strangely perceptive dog. She moves through her day as if nothing were amiss, until returning home to discover a surreal trail of blood that winds endlessly into the shadow-filled forest, alive with scavengers.

[From [url=https://vaguelygalaxy.itch.io/volatile-memory-blood-trail]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在与世隔绝的情况下，阿耳忒弥斯与一位不寻常的陌生人和一只顽固且具有奇怪洞察力的狗同住一间小屋。她度过了这一天，好像什么都没有发生一样，直到回到家，发现一条超现实的血迹蜿蜒无尽地进入充满阴影的森林，里面到处都是食腐动物。

[来自[url=https://vaguelygalaxy.itch.io/volatile-memory-blood-trail]Itch.io[/url]]
